avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer significantly reduces delavirdine plasma concentrations, compromising antiretroviral efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not use concurrently. Counsel patient to avoid all St. John's Wort products

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin/Rifabutin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 induction reduces delavirdine levels by >50%, leading to treatment failure and resistance
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid combination; use alternative antimycobacterial if TB treatment required

avoid_supplements.name: Garlic supplements (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may reduce delavirdine bioavailability
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose garlic supplements; dietary garlic in normal amounts acceptable

caution_supplements.name: Calcium/Iron supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May reduce delavirdine absorption if taken simultaneously due to chelation and pH effects
caution_supplements.action: Separate dosing by at least 2 hours; delavirdine requires acidic environment for optimal absorption

caution_supplements.name: Antacids (calcium-based)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Increases gastric pH, reducing delavirdine solubility and absorption
caution_supplements.action: If antacid needed, separate administration by ≥2 hours

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: May reduce delavirdine bioavailability; requires acidic environment for absorption
avoid_foods.action: Take delavirdine on empty stomach or with light meal; avoid heavy fatty foods within 1 hour of dosing

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase delavirdine levels and potential for adverse effects
caution_foods.action: Limit grapefruit consumption or monitor for increased side effects if consumed regularly

caution_foods.name: Cranberry juice
caution_foods.mechanism: May affect gastric pH and potentially reduce absorption
caution_foods.action: Consume in moderation; separate from delavirdine dosing if possible

monitoring_notes: Delavirdine requires acidic gastric environment for optimal absorption; monitor for reduced efficacy if gastric pH-altering agents are used. Regular CD4 count and viral load monitoring essential to detect treatment failure from significant interactions.
